candidates.name: Terminus Specialties, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage lists restroom partitions, partition hardware and repair kits with 'optional installation for all products'; contact page says it 'delivers expert installation and reliable service across partitions, doors, lockers, and safety products'.
candidates.reason: Commercial Division 10 supplier just south of Atlanta (McDonough, about 28 miles) that states it installs partitions for general contractors on commercial projects. No project photos of partitions seen, and it also sells partitions directly.
red_flags: Sells and supplies partitions itself (buy-around risk)
No partition project photos or brands seen
Email shown is a named person's address

license.name: Terminus Specialties, Inc.
license.registry: Georgia State Licensing Board for Residential and General Contractors (license verification at verify.sos.ga.gov); City of Atlanta business license (ATLBIZ) / Office of Buildings Accela portal
license.note: State lookup returned HTTP 403 to automated access (verify.sos.ga.gov and sos.ga.gov both 403 on 2026-11-19), so no state license record could be checked. Georgia's own rule for partition installers is still unclear (general contractor license over $2,500; possible specialty-contractor exemption not verified). City of Atlanta: no public business-license lookup found (business services moved to atlbiz.atlantaga.gov, which needs an account); the Office of Buildings Accela portal (aca-prod.accela.com/ATLANTA_GA/APO/APOLookup.aspx) offers 'Look Up by Licensed Professional' only through a postback search form, not checked. Company site lists restroom partitions with 'Optional installation for all products' and says it is based just south of Atlanta; no license number shown (https://www.terminusspecialties.com/). Confirm by phone with the state board and the City of Atlanta Office of Revenue.

candidates.name: Restroom Stalls and All (RSA)
candidates.review_source: Google (as shown on company homepage); BBB A+ accredited (as claimed on homepage)
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage says partitions are installed by 'our own W2 installers' in GA, FL, AL, TN, SC/NC; lists commercial projects incl. Grady Health System and Georgia Tech (Atlanta) and UGA Sanford Stadium.
candidates.reason: Clearly installs toilet partitions with its own crews on commercial jobs, including Atlanta projects. Base in Gainesville is about 50 miles from the area center, and it is primarily a partition seller (online instant quote, nationwide shipping), so it competes directly with Next Partitions.
red_flags: Direct competitor: sells partitions online with instant quotes and nationwide shipping (high buy-around risk)
Base city about 50 miles from Atlanta center, outside the 30-mile radius
Rating and BBB status are self-reported on its own site, not read on Google/BBB
